headline: Barcelona 59.4% favourites, but Madrid are closing the gap
summary: Barcelona are clear favourites for Sunday's Clasico at the Camp Nou, with a 59.4% chance to win. Real Madrid have gained ground, though: their win chance has risen from 19.8% to 24.1%. Barcelona are still rated about one goal better on the handicap at -1.02. The draw is the least likely result at 16.5%. The market expects a high-scoring game: the fair goals total is now 4.18, up from 4.03. Both teams to score is rated 73.2%, so clean sheets are not the expectation.
read: Barcelona are clear favourites at 59.4%, but the gap has narrowed: Real Madrid have come in from 19.8% to 24.1% and the handicap has slipped from Barcelona -1.19 to -1.02, so they are rated about one goal better rather than 1.2. The goals side has moved the other way, with the fair total up to 4.18 and over 4.25 close to a coin flip at 48.4% — both teams to score is rated 73.2%, while the draw is the outsider at 16.5%.
